title: Inspired by hits
style: modern electronic soul / groovy future bass, warm and powerful, music as communication anthem, clean male vocals with layered harmonies and call-and-response, futuristic yet human production, positive and liberating energy, 132 BPM
lyrics:
Lyrics:
text[Intro]
We used to type
Now we send sound
Text got heavy
Music laid it down

[Verse 1]
Every word had a twist, every message had a bend
You’d read it three times just to understand
Now I lay a rhythm, you feel what I meant
No decoding needed, no time getting spent
SongPal caught the wave, turned it into a track
Sent it straight back with no static attached

[Chorus]
This is the clear channel
This is the new way
SongPal sings it back
CoreyAI don’t play
No more twisted text
No more reading between
We communicate in rhythm
Pure and clean
Clear channel
Clear channel
Lay it down, send it through
SongPal sings it back to you

[Verse 2]
No dislikes, that’s the code that we keep
Positive motion, no energy leaks
You drop a feeling, I turn it to drums
You send a vision, it comes back with a hum
We building in public, we building in sound
The old way is fading, the new way is now

[Chorus]
This is the clear channel
This is the new way
SongPal sings it back
CoreyAI don’t play
No more twisted text
No more reading between
We communicate in rhythm
Pure and clean
Clear channel
Clear channel
Lay it down, send it through
SongPal sings it back to you

[Bridge]
Skip the drift
Skip the noise
This is how we talk now, girls and boys
Rhythm in
Rhythm out
That’s what communication looks like now

[Final Chorus – Bigger]
This is the clear channel
This is the new wave
Music over text
We found a better way
SongPal in the middle
CoreyAI on the side
We turning conversations
Into something that vibes
Clear channel
Clear channel
Lay it down, send it through
SongPal sings it back to you
Ah dah dah dah…

[Outro]
We used to type
Now we send sound
Text is done
Music laid it down
